5.t: WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct a new building with a bulk in excess of the
bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution of the City
of New York, effective December 15, 1961, as may be amended from time to time (the “"Zoning
Resolution"), as if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot;
WHEREAS, there exist Development Rights, which are appurtenant to the Owner Land
and which are not utilized by the Owner Building and are available for transfer pursuant to the
Zoning Resolution;
WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and
contemporaneously herewith (the “Declaration"), Owner and Developer have utilized the
procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner
Land with the Developer Land so as to create a new, combined zoning lot (the “Combined
Zoning Lot'") for the purpose of making available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter
defined) for utilization by Developer in connection with the development of the Developer Land
and as otherwise set forth in this Agreement; and
WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their
rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters, and wish to provide
to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to
seek any consent, approval or other action from the other.
